en.html:
For hiding a man, a train had one fatal deficiency. Width.
Go straight after him and I should find him.

If my eyes had not deceived me.

If they had—then there would be nobody.

Nobody, surely.

Roughly six meters between us.

en.html:
Kageaki"A hunting dog, then."
Sorimachi"Heh..."
Kageaki"Clive Cannon, the GHQ staff officer, chose you. Is that it? A Yamato man, once inside Aizu, can move about without worrying too much about the Sasagawa army..."
Kageaki"But crossing the border now, without reliable credentials, hardly seems possible. Or is the name of a Rokuhara hireling still so highly trusted?"
Sorimachi"Trusted? Arre, these days that name has less use than a charm against bad luck..."
Sorimachi"'Entire border sealed.' Big, big words. But have they built a wall all round? No. Just soldiers with guns, doing their rounds... Look for a gap, you find a gap..."
Sorimachi"No gap? Make one. Simple."
Kageaki"............Your owner allowed that?"
Kageaki"He did not tell you to leave uninvolved people unharmed?"
Sorimachi"Of course he did... With one little attachment: 'as far as possible.'"
Sorimachi"Not possible, then kya karein? Not possible."
Kageaki"..."
Sorimachi"Kheh, heh! Lieutenant Colonel Cannon understands very well... Give an order like that, and people will die. This much, he knows."
Sorimachi"He knows it, understands it, and gives it anyway. So afterward he won’t be sitting there with his regrets and lamentations."
Sorimachi"Not like you. First kill, then full rona-dhona."
Kageaki"........................"
Kageaki"He would go that far... to have me—"
Kageaki"To eliminate Captain Ootori and myself? Quite a grudge he is nursing."

ja.html:
景明「つまりは猟犬」
雪車町「へっ……」
景明「ＧＨＱ参謀クライブ・キャノンがお前を選んだ。そういう事か。 　大和人のお前なら、会津内への侵入にさえ 成功すれば、後は篠川軍の存在もさして気に せずに行動できる……」
景明「だがそれにしても、現状で確かな身元保証 もなしに越境するような真似が可能とは思え ないが。 　六波羅御雇の名は余程に信用があるのか？」
雪車町「なわきゃ、ねえでしょう……。 　今はそんなもん、厄除けのまじないほどの 御利益もありゃしませんよ」
雪車町「ま、全周封鎖なんて大仰に言おうが、別に 城壁を建てて並べてるわけじゃあない、兵士 が銃持って巡回してるだけですから……ねェ。 　穴くらい探せば見つかります……」
雪車町「無ければ無いで、開ければ・・・・いいだけの事で」
景明「…………。 　お前の飼い主はそれを許したのか」
景明「無関係の者に危害を加えるなとは、言わな かったのか？」
雪車町「言いましたさァ……。 　可能な限り、ってぇ注釈付きで」
雪車町「可能でなけりゃ、仕方ありません……」
景明「……」
雪車町「けッ、へぇっ！ 　キャノン中佐はわかっておいでですよ…… そういう命令の仕方をすれば必ず死人が出る ってことくらい」
雪車町「知ってて、わかっててやってるんだ……。 　だから、あの男は、やっちまった後で悔い たり嘆いたりなんかしねえよ」
雪車町「てめぇとは違う・・・・・・・」
景明「……………………」
景明「そこまでして…… 　彼は、俺を」
景明「俺と大鳥大尉を抹殺したいのか。 　随分と執念深い」

en.html:
No.
Was it a grudge at all...?

That man might have read us thoroughly. Read Captain Ootori, rather. She was not the type to hide away merely to keep herself safe. Perhaps he had decided with exactly that in mind.

What she might attempt in Aizu against GHQ—and such a plan did exist—
Had this sickly fellow been sent to prevent it?

　あの人物の事だ。

図って<ruby>逼塞<rt>ひっそく</rt></ruby>するような性分ではないことまで読み切り、

His bait could remain unbitten. I relaxed my knees and lowered myself a little.
What could he attack with? Prepare for that.

Sorimachi had one cane with a blade inside. No tsurugi.
Taking him bare-handed would be difficult. Impossible, it should not be.

...If necessary, I could have Muramasa help.
Chivalry with this specimen? Even I would not admire me for it.

挑発的な軽口には付き合わず。膝の力を抜き、腰を
わずかに沈める。
　敵の攻撃手段を予測し、それに備える。

　雪車町が持つのは杖――仕込み一振りだけだ。
　劒冑は無い。なら、素手で取り押さえることも難事
ではあれ無理ではない筈。

　……いざとなれば村正に手伝わせるまでだ。
　この相手に騎士道を気取ったところで、自己満足に
すらなりはしない。

en.html:
Sorimachi was fast on his feet.
His heart and lungs, going by his appearance, ought to have been unhealthy. On what arrangement they were permitting this speed, I could not understand at once.

To close the gap was difficult.
He was not getting further ahead. Very good—but we could not go on like this.

Somewhere ahead should be the carriage with the Sasagawa Kubo's soldiers.
Let him enter that carriage, and I could no longer simply chase after him.

If Chamberlain Nagakura's account was right, these were rear personnel without much fighting spirit. I could hardly suppose Sorimachi meant to set them against me.
Even so, trouble was certain.

I ought to catch him before that. Ought to—but...

en.html:
At last I understood what had happened.
For why it had happened, this understanding was utterly useless.

Our carriage, with me and the Ootori pair aboard, was cut off from the locomotive. Gradually losing speed. Fine. And then what?

Inconvenient, certainly. A fatal predicament, no.
What was the point of this schoolboy chutiyapa?

Had we been climbing a steep slope with another locomotive coming up behind us, we could have slid back into a terrible collision. But neither condition was present.

Peaceful, level country. Another bridge ahead.
Sorimachi’s carriages had picked up speed, perhaps from leaving ours behind. Already they were halfway across.

...The bridge was safe.
The man who had arranged all this was demonstrating it himself.

Surely he did not mean to destroy the bridge after his train crossed? That would require considerable explosives, or a gun. Of either, not a sign.

I could not understand.
But approaching ruin did not need my understanding to keep approaching. I could almost hear its footsteps.

The forward carriages completed the crossing.
Now ours approached the bridge.

Nothing happened.
Sorimachi did nothing.

Only raised his arm a little.
Toward the sky————

ja.html:
ようやくに現状事態を把握し。
　そして俺の困惑は更に深まった。

　こんな事をする意図が計り知れない。
　俺と大鳥主従が乗った車両は機関車から切り離され、
徐々に速度を落としている――だから、何なのか。

　不都合には違いないが、全く致命的な窮地とは言え
ない。
　何故……こんな、子供の悪戯のような真似を？

　今がまさに急勾配の坂道を登っている最中で、後方
からは別の機関車が迫っているような時でもあったの
なら、この列車は滑落したすえ凄惨な衝突事故を起こ
したことであろうが。そんな状況ではないのだ。

　列車はのどかな平地を走り抜け、再び橋に差し掛か
ろうとするところだった。
　先行する雪車町らの車両は、こちらを捨てたせいか
速度を増し、既に橋の半ばまで達している。

　……橋は安全だ。
　この状況を仕組んだ当の本人が、今それを証明して
いる。

　まさか……自分の列車が渡り終えた後で、橋を破壊
しようとでも云うのだろうか。
　それには相当量の爆弾、あるいは砲門が必要となる
筈だが、そんなものは影も形も見えない。

　わからなかった。
　……わからぬままに、俺は忍び寄る破滅の足音だけ
を聞いている。

　先行車が橋を渡り終えた。
　入れ違いに、<ruby>後続<rt>こちら</rt></ruby>が橋へ近付く。

　何も起こらない。
　雪車町は何もしない。

　ただ軽く、腕を上げて。
　空に――――
